summary.zh: 外壳酥脆、酸甜明亮，一盘端上桌就被抢光的国民菜。
summary.en: Crackling-crisp pork in a glossy sweet-sour glaze — the crowd-pleaser that vanishes first at any table.

ingredients.zh: 白糖 3 大勺、白醋 2 大勺

ingredients.en: 1 tbsp cooking wine, salt to taste

steps.zh: 里脊切成小指粗的条，加料酒和盐抓匀腌 10 分钟。
steps.en: Cut the tenderloin into finger-sized strips; marinate with cooking wine and salt for 10 minutes.

steps.zh: 调糊：鸡蛋打散，加淀粉、面粉和少许水，调成能挂住筷子的稠糊。
steps.en: Make the batter: beat the egg with cornstarch, flour and a little water until it coats a chopstick.

steps.zh: 肉条挂糊，六成油温（约 160°C）逐条下锅，初炸至定型微黄捞出。
steps.en: Coat the strips and deep-fry one by one at 160°C until set and pale golden; remove.

steps.zh: 油温升至八成（约 180°C），复炸 1 分钟至金黄酥脆，捞出沥油。
steps.en: Raise the oil to 180°C and fry again for 1 minute until deeply golden and crisp.

steps.zh: 锅留少许油，下番茄酱、白糖、白醋和 2 大勺水煮开，勾薄芡熬至浓稠起泡。
steps.en: In a little oil, simmer ketchup, sugar, vinegar and 2 tbsp water; thicken lightly until glossy and bubbling.

steps.zh: 倒入里脊快速翻裹 10 秒，让每条均匀挂汁，撒芝麻立即出锅。
steps.en: Toss in the pork for just 10 seconds to glaze every strip, shower with sesame and serve at once.

tips.zh: 复炸是酥脆的关键：初炸定型，复炸逼出水分，外壳才能挺住糖醋汁。
tips.en: Double-frying is the secret: the first pass sets the crust, the second drives out moisture so it survives the sauce.

tips.zh: 汁熬浓再下肉，翻裹不超过 10 秒——泡久了脆壳立刻回软。
tips.en: Thicken the sauce before the pork goes in, and toss no more than 10 seconds — a long soak kills the crunch.

tips.zh: 家庭版用番茄酱颜色红亮稳定；传统派用糖色加陈醋，酸味更醇。
tips.en: Ketchup gives a stable, bright-red glaze; the traditional route uses caramel and aged vinegar for a deeper sourness.

failChecks.zh: 外壳软塌：没复炸，或肉在汁里翻太久，严格控制在 10 秒内。
failChecks.en: Soggy crust? Skipped the second fry or tossed too long — keep it under 10 seconds.

failChecks.zh: 太酸或太甜：糖醋以 2:3 为基准，熬汁时边尝边调。
failChecks.en: Too sharp or too sweet? Start from a 2:3 vinegar-to-sugar ratio and taste as it simmers.

failChecks.zh: 挂糊脱落：糊太稀或油温太低，糊要能挂住筷子、逐条下锅。
failChecks.en: Batter sliding off? It was too thin or the oil too cool — the batter should cling, and strips go in one by one.

culturalStory.zh: 糖醋味型源自中原，宋代已有「糖醋」入菜的记载。里脊做法在清代食单中渐成定式，以酥炸裹汁为正宗。19 世纪它随粤菜移民漂洋过海，演变出美式「Sweet and Sour Pork」，成为中餐西化的活化石——一盘糖醋里脊，半部中餐出海史。
culturalStory.en: The sweet-sour flavor profile traces back to Song Dynasty China. The crisp-fried, glaze-coated tenderloin became canon in Qing cookbooks, then sailed overseas with Cantonese migrants in the 19th century — evolving into American 'Sweet and Sour Pork.' One plate of this dish tells half the story of Chinese food going global.
